meaning: The intuitionist theory (bundle TruthCore.Comparison.ExcludedMiddle.Intuitionist, five commitments from the pinned SEP witness) entails withholding excluded middle without denying it: the assertion rule for p ∨ ¬p, an instance not asserted at some stage, and every denial refuted. Withholding is derived from the theory's own account of assertion and proof, so the rival does not win by subtraction. Truth is provability is part of the bundle but not needed for this conclusion; it is the theory's answer to Q-TRUTH.
